<title level="1" right="Spell 2" pfs="Standard">
[Everlight](/Spells.aspx?ID=1518)
<actions string="Three Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Light" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=100" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 329

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Divine](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=2), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3), [Primal](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=4)

<row gap="medium">

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** touch

**Target** a gemstone worth 6 gp or more
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** unlimited
</row>

</column>

---

The gemstone you touch glows, spreading [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=407) with a color of your choice in a 20-foot radius (and [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=408) for the next 20 feet). The spell ends immediately if the gemstone is [broken](/Conditions.aspx?ID=2).
name: Everlight
